shortBulletSummary: The stronger-than-expected August US jobs report reduced market expectations for Federal Reserve interest rate cuts, leading to a sell-off in risk assets, including cryptocurrencies.
Spot Bitcoin ETF inflows significantly decreased by 76% after the release of the strong US jobs report.
Sentiment across Ethereum derivatives has slightly slipped into negative territory, and ETH's price fell over 2% in the last 24 hours.
Coinbase has begun offering regulated crypto derivatives trading in Canada, indicating expanding institutional offerings.
South Korea announced plans to start tokenizing all types of securities in three stages from 2027.
